description: This file contains folder operations for managing datasource folders, including creation, resetting to defaults, filtering items by search, enriching folder children with metadata, and ensuring default folder presence. It handles CRUD operations and data mutations related to datasource folder structures in a Superset frontend component.

methods.name: createFolder
methods.description: Creates a new folder object with a unique UUID and specified name.

methods.name: resetToDefault
methods.description: Resets folder structure to default metrics and columns folders populated with provided metrics and columns.

methods.name: filterItemsBySearch
methods.description: Filters metrics and columns based on a search term, returning matching item UUIDs.

methods.name: enrichFolderChildren
methods.description: Enrichs folder children with names and types from metrics and columns data, based on UUIDs.

methods.name: ensureDefaultFolders
methods.description: Ensures that default metrics and columns folders exist, creating them if missing, and enriches existing folder structure.
